author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at the world of self-hosting again. ChatGPT and it's frontier cohorts have ruined many aspects of our world let alone the Internet. This technology that powers it will never go away, so in that spirit it's time to take back that technology and use it for yourself without being given permissions by a few companies at the top. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: NEVER use ChatGPT again...
